invariants.rationale: The method always returns an Option, which should not be null.
instantTime is required to identify the instant and is used as a mandatory argument throughout the API.
instantToRollback is required to know which instant to roll back and should not be null upon method exit.
If a rollback plan exists, usually only one of marker-based rollback or restore is expected to be active, based on rollback semantics.
If timeline publishing is not skipped, then a rollback plan should have been generated.
